$description: Component sizing under cognitive-accessibility mode, applied when the consumer sets [data-a11y-cognitive="true"]. These are overrides, not a second component system: a consumer swaps the value it reads for the cognitive one and changes nothing else. Every minimum height resolves through cognitiveTarget.min, so the mode has exactly one target-size decision to review.

cognitive-button.$description: Ported from finance, which authored primary, secondary and destructive separately with identical values. Collapsed to one set plus the border width the outline variant needs — three copies of one decision is how the three drift apart.

padding-x.$description: Roomier horizontal padding for a larger hit area.

radius.$description: Softer corner than the default control radius.

border-width.$description: Thicker border so an outline button reads as a control, not as text.

border-width.$description: Thicker border so the field boundary is unambiguous.
Thicker border so the card boundary does not rely on a shadow.

gap.$description: Gap between elements inside the card.

item-padding-x.$description: Roomier horizontal padding on navigation items.

item-padding-y.$description: Roomier vertical padding on navigation items.

item-gap.$description: Separation between adjacent targets, so a near miss lands on nothing rather than on the wrong item.

gap.$description: Separation between adjacent rows, so a near miss lands on nothing rather than on the wrong row.
